apple.title: Bolo: Speak Hindi
apple.subtitle: Real-life conversation skills
apple.description:
Practice Hindi for the moments that happen in real life.

Bolo helps you move from recognizing words to choosing a natural response. Work through 102 short lessons in 11 guided plans, plus 30 standalone real-life scenes for cafés, transport, shopping, travel, work, social visits, and everyday errands. Health scenes are language exercises and do not provide medical advice.

GUIDED PRACTICE
• Read Hindi in Devanagari with transliteration and an English meaning
• Choose a response and get immediate feedback
• Hear bundled Hindi lesson audio offline
• Save useful phrases for quick review
• Track your daily practice and streak on your device

OPTIONAL COACHING WITH ASHA
After a separate consent step, use AI Listen, type a message, or start an Asha GPT-Live conversation. Choose Hindi immersion, English help, beginner, conversation, or lesson mode; then use Mute, Interrupt, or End Chat while speaking naturally. You can also record a scene answer for focused pronunciation feedback. Generated AI voice and connected coaching require an internet connection.

YOUR CHOICE
The 102 short lessons and 30 standalone scenes, bundled lesson audio, saved phrases, and practice progress are available without an account or internet. AI features are optional, and consent can be withdrawn in Settings. AI replies can be reported from inside the conversation.

Bolo is a language-practice tool. AI responses may be inaccurate; do not rely on Bolo for professional translation, medical advice, or emergency help.

apple.reviewNotes:
No account, login, purchase, or subscription is required. The 102 short lessons, 11 guided plans, and 30 standalone scenes work without connected coaching.

To review a guided scene:
1. Open any scene from Home.
2. Tap Listen to hear bundled offline Hindi audio; this does not require AI consent, a network connection, or a device text reader.
3. Choose a response to reveal feedback or save the natural answer.

To review connected coaching:
1. Open Practice with Asha.
2. Accept AI data-use consent notice version 9 if it is not already enabled.
3. Keep English selected, type How do I say thank you?, and verify an English reply with generated AI voice playback.
4. Select हिन्दी, type the same question, and verify a Hindi reply.
5. Tap Start Conversation. This requests microphone permission and opens a full-duplex WebRTC media stream. Its microphone track stays enabled during the active chat so the learner can speak naturally or interrupt Asha; Mute disables it until unmuted. The stream and its tracks are released at End Chat, when leaving the screen, or when the app leaves the foreground. Live voice does not create a recording file or capture microphone audio in the background.
6. On a generated reply, tap Report and choose a reason to test the in-app AI-content reporting path.
7. In Settings, withdraw AI processing consent to disable generated AI playback and all connected coaching.

Generated AI voice and connected coaching require internet access. The pharmacy and doctor scenes teach language phrasing and do not provide medical advice. Bolo does not record in the background.
